GENERAL WARRANTY DEED

STATE OF TEXAS
COUNTY OF TRAVIS

KNOW ALL PERSONS BY THESE PRESENTS:

That Marisol Ferreira-Nkemelu and spouse, Daniel Okoye Nkemelu, of Travis County, Texas (collectively, "Grantor"), for and in consideration of the sum of TEN AND NO/100 DOLLARS ($10.00) and other good and valuable consideration paid by Harlan Whitcombe Trust dated April 3, 2019 (the "Grantee"), the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, has GRANTED, SOLD, AND CONVEYED, and by these presents does GRANT, SELL, AND CONVEY unto Grantee all of the following described real property in Travis County, Texas:

Lot 14, Block C, WESTON HOLLOW SECTION TWO, a subdivision in Travis County, Texas, according to the map or plat thereof recorded in Volume 84, Page 213, Plat Records of Travis County, Texas, together with all improvements thereon (the "Property").

This conveyance is made subject to the following: (a) restrictive covenants of record; (b) ad valorem taxes for 2026 and subsequent years, which Grantee assumes; and (c) all easements and rights-of-way of record.

TO HAVE AND TO HOLD the Property, together with all and singular the rights and appurtenances thereto belonging, unto Grantee, Grantee's successors and assigns forever.

Grantor binds Grantor and Grantor's heirs, executors, administrators, and successors to WARRANT AND FOREVER DEFEND all and singular the Property unto Grantee, Grantee's successors and assigns, against every person whomsoever lawfully claiming or to claim the same or any part thereof, except as to the matters set forth above.

EXECUTED this 6th day of February, 2026.

/s/ Marisol Ferreira-Nkemelu
Marisol Ferreira-Nkemelu

/s/ Daniel Okoye Nkemelu
Daniel Okoye Nkemelu

STATE OF TEXAS
COUNTY OF TRAVIS
